en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:

Dhammapaccanīya (2), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 10.1. Kusala-ttika, Hetu-duka The Section on the Positive and Negative Relations of the Dhammas (Dhammapaccanīya) within the Conditional Relations Treatise (Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa), specifically the Textual Recitation of the Triplets and Couplets (Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi). 10.1.
The Triplet of the Wholesome (Kusalattika) and the Couplets on Roots (Hetuduka).
Cause:
Homage to that Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Perfectly Self-Awakened One.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a cause, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor a cause, by way of the root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Neither wholesome...
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted and without root, there arises a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted and without root, by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted and without root, there arises a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-rooted and without root, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted and without root, there arise states that are both neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted and without root, and neither-indeterminate-nor-rooted and without root, by way of root-condition.

Conditioned by root-condition (*hetupaccaya*). Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a root, there arise states that are neither wholesome nor roots and neither unwholesome nor roots, by way of root-condition; ... [five cases].
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor a root, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor a root, by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted, there arises a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted, there arises a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-rooted by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted, there arise states that are both neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted and neither-indeterminate-nor-rooted by way of root-condition.

They arise by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root, there arise states that are neither-wholesome-nor-root and neither-unwholesome-nor-root by way of root condition … five [cases].
Dependent on a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-root, there arises a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-root by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-undefined-nor-root, there arises a state that is neither-wholesome-nor-root by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-undefined-nor-root, there arises a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-undefined-nor-root, there arise states that are neither-unwholesome-nor-root and neither-undefined-nor-root [by way of root-condition].

[They] arise by way of root condition. Dependent on a non-indeterminate, non-root phenomenon, there arise non-wholesome, non-root phenomena and non-indeterminate, non-root phenomena by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-indeterminate, non-root phenomenon, there arise non-wholesome, non-root phenomena and non-unwholesome, non-root phenomena by way of root condition … six.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause and a state that is neither indeterminate nor root-cause, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause and a state that is neither indeterminate nor root-cause, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor root-cause by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause and a state that is neither indeterminate nor root-cause...
Dependent on a state that is neither-undefined-nor-root, a state that is neither-undefined-nor-root arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on states that are neither-wholesome-nor-root and neither-undefined-nor-root, states that are neither-wholesome-nor-root and neither-undefined-nor-root arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on states that are neither-wholesome-nor-root and neither-undefined-nor-root...
Neither-unwholesome-nor-root and neither-unwholesome-nor-root phenomena arise by way of root-condition … five [cases].

Dependent on a phenomenon that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root and not-root, and a phenomenon that is neither-indeterminate-nor-root and not-root, a phenomenon that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root and not-root arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root and not-root, and a phenomenon that is neither-indeterminate-nor-root and not-root … [and so forth].

A non-unwholesome, non-root dhamma arises conditioned by root-condition. Dependent on a non-unwholesome, non-root and a non-indeterminate, non-root dhamma, a non-indeterminate, non-root dhamma arises conditioned by root-condition.
Dependent on a non-unwholesome, non-root and a non-indeterminate, non-root dhamma, non-unwholesome, non-root and non-indeterminate, non-root dhammas [arise].

They arise by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Dependent on states that are neither-unwholesome-nor-root and neither-indeterminate-nor-root, there arise states that are neither-unwholesome-nor-root and neither-unwholesome-nor-root by way of root-condition … five.
Dependent on states that are neither-unwholesome-nor-root and neither-unwholesome-nor-root, there arises a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root by way of root-condition.

By way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*). Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root and neither-unwholesome-nor-root, there arises a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root and neither-unwholesome-nor-root, there arise states that are both neither-unwholesome-nor-root and neither-unwholesome-nor-root by way of root condition… three [combinations]. (Abbreviated.)

With respect to the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*), there are twenty-nine; with respect to the object condition (*ārammaṇa-paccaya*), there are twenty-four ... pe ... with respect to the ripening condition (*vipāka-paccaya*), there are nine ... pe ... with respect to the non-disappearance condition (*avigata-paccaya*), there are twenty-nine. (The full detail applies everywhere.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a root-condition (*na-kusala na-hetu*), a state that is neither wholesome nor a root-condition arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a root-condition, a state that is unwholesome and not a root-condition arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a non-wholesome, non-root dhamma, a non-indeterminate, non-root dhamma arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a non-wholesome, non-root dhamma, both a non-wholesome, non-root dhamma and a non-indeterminate, non-root dhamma arise by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a non-wholesome, non-root dhamma, both a non-wholesome, non-root dhamma and...
Unwholesome, non-root phenomena arise by way of root condition from unwholesome, non-root phenomena.
Dependent on an unwholesome, non-root phenomenon, an unwholesome, non-root phenomenon arises by way of root condition … five.
Dependent on an indeterminate, non-root phenomenon, an indeterminate, non-root phenomenon arises by way of root condition … five.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-conditioned and neither indeterminate nor root-conditioned, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor root-conditioned by way of the root condition ... three.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor root-conditioned and neither indeterminate nor root-conditioned, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor root-conditioned by way of the root condition ... three.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-conditioned and neither unwholesome nor root-conditioned, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor root-conditioned by way of the root condition ... three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, twenty-four; in the case of the object condition, twenty-four …pe… in the case of the result condition, nine …pe… in the case of the non-disappearance condition, twenty-four. (The full detail applies in all cases.)
